notes.title: Watch the Worlds finals in Virtex this Sunday!
notes.notes:
WeiboGaming and T1 will fight for the League of Legends world title this Sunday! If you haven't checked our dedicated Worlds stadium yet, this is your last chance! We have giant champion statues in our lobby and a big surprise in the stadium itself...

Make sure to update your Virtex Playtest app and join other League fans for the ultimate final!

The app will be open from 7.30 AM GMT / 8.30 AM CET / 2.30 AM ET


See you in the Stadium!

notes.title: Watch League of Legends Worlds in our Watch Party Stadium!!
notes.notes:
We are reopening the doors of the stadium for the next playtest session!  This time we have designed a unique Watch Party Stadium for the League of Legends Worlds competition. Make sure to come and check it out for yourself on game days!

The stadium will be open on the following days (approximative competition start time 8 AM CET):

Quarter-finals: Nov 2-5

Semi-finals: Nov 11-12

Finals: Nov 19


See you in the Stadium!

notes.title: New Virtex Stadium Playtest this week-end!!
notes.notes:
[b]Virtex Stadium Playtest returns online on September 8/9/10 with the TFT SuperBrawl![/b]


We will be showing the whole SuperBrawl tournament. Servers will open from 15:15 CEST until the end of each day's competition.

We have implemented two main fixes to the build: the stream should load much faster, and it shouldn't require nearly as much RAM - we'd love to hear your feedback about it!


See you in the Stadium to watch some TFT or just to hangout!

notes.title: VALORANT CHAMPIONS LA is back for the semis & finals!
notes.notes:
Join the virtual watch party and be sure to bring your friends to watch the VALORANT CHAMPIONS finals in Virtex Stadium! Who from Evil Geniuses, Paper Rex, Loud or Fnatic will win it all?

Playtest Servers will be live from 8:30 PM CEST // 11:30 AM PT every day from the 24th to Saturday 26th of August.


See you in the stadium!

notes.title: Come watch the VALORANT LA CHAMPIONS playoffs!!!
notes.notes:
We’re bringing VALORANT back! We will be showing the competition starting from the playoffs on the 16th of August all the way to the finals on the 26th. Make sure to go on the store page and click “request access to the playtest” if you haven't already!


Servers will be online each day of the competition from 8.30 PM CEST / 11.30 AM PT until the end of the last game.

notes.title: Watch the Valorant VCT Tokyo Finals in the Watch Party Stadium!
notes.notes:
[h1]Sign-up now to join the special Steam Playtest this week-end![/h1]


We will be showing the Valorant VCT Tokyo finals inside our Watch Party Stadium as part of an open Steam playtest. Make sure to request access now if you want to discover this new type of stadium - you'll also be able to visit the lobby, our big social space where everyone can hangout with friends and other fans before the games.

[i]Servers will be online on both Saturday 24th and Sunday 25th from 7 PM PT / 10 PM ET / 4 AM CEST. [/i]
